line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: ZH.JumpBeacon.Respawn
* DESCRIPTION: Called by ZH.Monitor during an OCV playthrough.
* This script is called every 90 minutes. On all difficulties, 1 beacon is guaranteed to respawn in a sector with a Phanon outpost, as long as the sector does not have a jump beacon.
* Phanon can get additional jump beacons spawned in their sectors and in commonwealth space. The base chance is 10% in their territory.
* On hard, the chances are 20% in their territory and 5% outside.
* On insane, the chances are increased to 40% inside Phanon space and 20% outside.
* The number of attempts to spawn in commonwealth space is equal to the number of sectors Phanon owns.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 16 November 2025
* If Phanon has no sectors, return.
* The number of Phanon sectors in the galaxy is used as the max number of attempts when trying to spawn beacons outside Phanon space.
* Compute these thresholds once. This is used to decide whether to rebuild additional beacons in Phanon space.
* Add-Ons 1.10.2: Chances increased (hard: 10 -> 20, insane: 20 -> 40)
* Insane: 40% chance.
* Hard: 20% chance.
* Easy and normal: 10% chance.
* Beacons cannot respawn in sectors without an Outpost.
* Check if there a jump beacon! If there's no beacon, the first spawn is guaranteed.
* Add-Ons 1.4.24: Fixed - removed flags. (1.6: Fixed again by setting all other flags to null.)
* Tell the player when the first beacon respawns inside Phanon space.

line.text: 'Alert: Phanon Outposts are establishing and maintaining a jump network within their territory.'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.10.2: Used up guaranteed spawn, so now rebuild at other sectors. Chances are reduced on easy/normal to 10%.
* Spawn additional beacons. Must have no beacon in this sector to spawn additional beacons.
* Go through ALL commonwealth (including Yaki) sectors.
* For each sector in the array, attempt to spawn a beacon until Phanon is out of attempts.
* Add-Ons 1.10.2: Chances increased (2.5 -> 5, 10 -> 20)
* Hard difficulty has a 5% chance.
* Insane mode has a 20% chance.
* Get a randomized list of sectors.
* Filter conditions: skip player's active sector, Renegade sector, and non-commonwealth (Xenon and player) sectors.
* Stop if we've reached our attempt budget.
* Filter out playership's current sector, Renegade sector, and incompatible factions.
* Check if there a jump beacon! If there's no jump beacon in this sector, try to spawn one!
* Tell the player when the first beacon respawns outside Phanon space.

line.text: 'Alert: Phanon has begun extending its jump network beyond its territory.'
